\chapter{Assessments and annual preparation}\label{EVAL}
The T1 and T2 versions are available to students. The A and B versions and all the solutions are reserved for the teacher. The papers are original; they are not presented as official past papers. The approaches change between versions: direct or inverse model, optimisation or relative position, direct or reversed tree, projection or locus.
